show.title: Restoration at Grayson Manor
show.headline: Chris Colfer stars in your new favorite camp horror jam.

event.title: <show-title>Restoration at Grayson Manor</show-title><event-type-title> with Live Q&A</event-type-title>
event.headline: With director Glenn McQuaid in attendance.
event.description:
Boyd Grayson is an Irish playboy who delights in bringing men home to his sprawling family estate for sex, just to spite his legacy-obsessed mother, reminding her she’ll never get the grandchildren she craves. When an accident leaves him incapacitated, Boyd finds himself handless, helpless, and at the mercy of her care.

Luckily for Boyd, his mother’s familial wealth has given him the opportunity to be the first person in the history of the world to pilot an experimental technology: mechanical hands controlled entirely by his subconscious. Soon, however, the hands begin to move on their own… even when they’re not attached to Boyd’s body.

Chris Colfer playing Irish, Alice Krige playing a matriarch trying to rebuild her son at any cost. Add to the mix disembodied hands that come to life, a crumbling estate full of barbed arguments, and a gallery of characters as despicable as they are magnetic. Colfer and Krige are delicious as cinema’s most twisted mother-son duo you can’t help but adore, and Declan Reynolds as Lee will become the new horror heartthrob of your gay dreams.

Director Glenn McQuaid embraces the melodrama with a sharp eye and fearless sincerity, grounding the film’s outrageous premise in real emotion.

While always funny, the film feels authentic and sincere, expressing pain around queer acceptance and the need for familial bonds even when those relationships can be painful. THE RESTORATION AT GRAYSON MANOR is fun, it’s sexy, it has some astounding grounded camerawork, and we’ll all learn the importance of a satisfying helping hand. (AUSTIN KING)

event.title: <show-title>Littermates</show-title> <event-type-title>Advance Screening</event-type-title>
event.headline: Catch the latest Alamo Exclusives film early
event.description:
At Chester’s cottage, good behavior earns karaoke. Getting answers is a little more complicated.

After a mysterious apocalyptic(ish) attack leaves them bloodied, disoriented, and unable to speak, Liam (Joey Bader) and Mel (Kaylee McGregor) take refuge in the English countryside. Their oddball host, Chester (Oliver Woolf), feeds them, helps them recover, and introduces a system of rewards: behave yourself, earn “nifties,” cash them in for hot-tub time and dance parties.

Beyond the cottage, things are less nifty. But within it, a makeshift family is taking shape. While Liam embraces their new life, Mel grows increasingly curious about the world Chester insists is too dangerous to enter…

In their feature debut, directors Scott Tinkham and Michael Woloson mix deadpan comedy, sibling rivalry, and creeping unease in a coming-of-age story about people who have to grow up all over again. Winner of the Special Jury Prize at the 2026 Manchester Film Festival and the Narrative Feature Audience Award at Dances With Films LA 2026, this has the sort of sensibilities that fans of Yorgos Lanthimos and Ben Wheatley will adore… and it’s a natural fit as an Alamo Exclusive.

event.title: <show-title>The Texas Chain Saw Massacre (1974)</show-title><event-type-title> with Live Q&A</event-type-title>
event.headline: Featuring discussions with cast & crew!
event.description:
DTLA - with Daniel Pearl (cinematographer)
DFW / Cedars - with Ed Neal (actor)
Austin / Village - with Ed Guinn, Teri MicMinn and Allen Danziger (actors)

Nothing will ever diminish the power of THE TEXAS CHAIN SAW MASSACRE. Shot through a cinéma vérité lens, director Tobe Hooper's ferocious classic follows five friends that fall victim to the grotesque Leatherface and his cannibalistic family. With a beautifully raw DIY aesthetic and powerful performances, this shockingly realistic film revolutionized the horror landscape when it was unleashed on a politically and socially tumultuous America in 1974. Facing controversy and censorship throughout its troubled release, THE TEXAS CHAIN SAW MASSACRE has stood the test of time to become a landmark film and cultural milestone.

event.description:
After his sister dies under mysterious circumstances while on vacation, Wai Lun decides to take matters into his own hands. Soon enough, he discovers a family curse, battling wizards, and centipedes — lots and lots of centipedes. Written by Suet Ming Chan (making this one of the only Hong Kong Category III horror movies written by a woman) and filled with creepy crawlies, melodrama, evil spirits, a very cute dog, and insect-barfing, CENTIPEDE HORROR is a true discovery for adventurous horror-fiends. Never released on home video in the U.S., AGFA is proud to present a new 2K preservation from the only 35mm film print in existence!

show.title: Daughters of Darkness
show.headline: They are waiting for you...they thrive on blood!

event.title: <show-title>Daughters of Darkness</show-title>
event.headline: Delphine Seyrig dazzles in this 1970s erotic lesbian vampire cult classic
event.description:
"I'm just an outmoded character, nothing more. You know, the beautiful stranger, slightly sad, slightly… mysterious… that haunts one place after another."

In the early 1970s, hardboiled crime films were all the rage: CHINATOWN, THE GODFATHER, THE FRENCH CONNECTION dominated the cineplex across the country. But simultaneously, there was another genre on the rise: the erotic lesbian vampire film. From THE VAMPIRE LOVERS to SHIVER OF THE VAMPIRES to VAMPYRES (which you know is queer because of its unconventional spelling), the era was riddled with attempts to cash in on the new lezzie blood-sucking craze. A standout from the red deluge of immortal sapphic stories was DAUGHTERS OF DARKNESS, a French, Belgian, and German collaboration helmed by Harry Kümel. When chaotic newlywed couple Valerie (Danielle Ouimet) and Stefan (John Karlen) arrive at a grand hotel on the Ostend seafront during the off-season, they initially seem to be the only guests in residence. That is, until the glamorous and preternaturally youthful Hungarian countess Elizabeth Báthory (Delphine Seyrig) arrives with her icy secretary Ilona (Andrea Rau). The Countess quickly becomes fixated on Valerie, and the dubious honeymoon is thrown into bizarre and erotic disarray.

Featuring an incredible and funky score by François de Roubaix and stunning decadent garments, DAUGHTERS OF DARKNESS is a vibe, and it’s so queeeeer. Decadent, alluring, dreamy, and strange, we can’t wait to watch this gorgeous film with you on the big screen as part of Queer Film Theory 10. Come, glamorous darlings, haunt us with your startling visage.

show.title: A Tale of Two Sisters
show.headline: Every family has its dark secrets

event.title: <show-title>A Tale of Two Sisters</show-title>
event.headline: Sad Girl Cinema Club gets spooky with Kim Jee-woon’s top tier twisted tale
event.description:
A TALE OF TWO SISTERS begins with Su-mi’s (Im Soo-jung) return home from her time away at a mental institution, and her homecoming is less than ideal. Her heavily medicated stepmother Eun-joo (Yum Jung-ah) rules the house, erratic and violent, she often terrified her younger sister Su-yeon (Moon Geun-young). However, their stepmother is not the only one wreaking havoc in their home: the ghost of their mother also haunts them in the evenings, fragmenting the barrier between what is real and what is psychosis.

Korean New Wave spearhead Kim Jee-woon’s diabolical fairy tale is filled with twists and turns. A TALE OF TWO SISTERS is an achingly haunted tale of sisterhood, evil stepmothers, and deadbeat dads. A luscious slow burn, the film to this day remains one of the most affecting Korean horror films of all time.

What is girlhood without a little bit of insanity?

event.description: Universal Pictures is proud to announce the nationwide theatrical re-release of WILD AT HEART (unrated version), the Academy Award®-nominated road-trip thriller from four-time Oscar®-nominated filmmaker David Lynch (BLUE VELVET, MULHOLLAND DRIVE), starring Oscar® winners Nicolas Cage (LEAVING LAS VEGAS) and Laura Dern (MARRIAGE STORY). A sexy and savage journey through the menacing underworld of the American South, WILD AT HEART returns to theaters in a new 4K digital restoration across the country beginning October 30, 2026, for a special limited engagement.

show.title: Ginger Snaps
show.headline: They don't call it the curse for nothing

event.title: <show-title>Ginger Snaps</show-title>
event.headline: The ultimate feminist werewolf parable
event.description: One of the dumbest prejudices perpetuated by the world is that menstrual cycles turn women into monsters. That conceit is what makes GINGER SNAPS so powerful. The Fitzgerald sisters (Katharine Isabelle and Emily Perkins) are death-obsessed high school goths who create violent art projects while battling the popular kids. But everything changes when someone’s period – and a werewolf – enters the picture. Written by Karen Walton as a feminist werewolf parable, GINGER SNAPS is an essential Y2K ripper that has lost none of its freshness, relevance, or bite over the past two decades.

show.headline: Human fangs ripping throats - no sawdust can soak up the torrent of blood!

event.title: <show-title>Vampire Circus</show-title>
event.headline: Human fangs ripping throats - no sawdust can soak up the torrent of blood!
event.description:
One of Hammer Films’ most lurid outings, eschewing the typical Christopher Lee / Peter Cushing path and instead mirroring the more permissive Seventies and its outrageous auteurs like Ken Russell. Plus, it fuses vampire lore with the trappings of circus / carnival thrillers like FREAKS and NIGHTMARE ALLEY.

Seeking revenge for a brutally-slain little girl, the townspeople of a tiny Austrian village murder the evil Count Mitterhaus… only for him to curse the villagers and vow that all their children will die so that he may return to live. Fifteen years later, as the village is ravaged by the plague, a travelling circus of shape-shifting vampires comes town town and makes everyone realize that the Count’s prophecy is coming true! (AGFA)

event.title: <show-title>A Desert</show-title> <event-type-title>w/ Live Q&A</event-type-title>
event.headline: Live Q&A with Director Joshua Erkman
event.description: The shocking debut thriller from director Joshua Erkman, A DESERT is vicious doom and precise horror splattered and shattered across the rural back alleys of the Southwest. Photographer Alex (Kai Lennox, GREEN ROOM) wants to take pictures of the real America: a brutalist desert full of trauma, liminal buildings and ugly beauty that might revive his career. When Alex chances upon a reckless couple in a dingy motel, he suddenly disappears without a trace. Enter the shady detective (David Yow of iconic post-punk band The Jesus Lizard) who searches for whereabouts in this nerve-shredding slow burn. (AGFA)

show.headline: Never let the truth get in the way of a good yarn.

event.title: <show-title>Chopper</show-title>
event.headline: Never let the truth get in the way of a good yarn.
event.description: An instant classic upon its release in 2000, this debut feature by Andrew Dominik (THE ASSASSINATON OF JESSE JAMES) hasn’t lost any of its power to shock and make you guffaw with huge laughs. Eric Bana’s breakthrough role in CHOPPER is that of real-life convict and author Mark “Chopper” Read: son of a devoutly religious mother, wisecracking criminal bungler and ultraviolent weirdo. Chopper’s “outlaw hero” status stems from his disdain for middle-class mores and inscrutable, childlike decisions (which, while horrifying in real life, make for an incredible cinematic thrillride.) Combined with Dominik’s exaggerated lighting schemes and wild angles, Bana’s performances is one for the ages.

event.title: <show-title>Manos: The Hands of Fate</show-title>
event.headline: The master would not approve
event.description:
Q: Are we not men?
A: WE ARE MANOS!

Mike (Harold P. Warren) and Maggie (Diane Mahree) are on a road trip with their daughter and family dog. But they take a wrong turn and wind up at a lodge inhabited by a polygamous pagan cult! The family finds themselves in the middle of a power struggle between caretaker Torgo (John Reynolds), cult leader The Master (Tom Neyman), and two warring factions of the Master’s wives. The sole directorial effort of Texas fertilizer salesman Warren, MANOS: THE HANDS OF FATE is an absurdist masterpiece. Prepare to exit the planet.

show.title: Thir13en Ghosts
show.headline: Misery loves company

event.title: <show-title>Thir13en Ghosts</show-title>
event.headline: Misery loves company in 35mm
event.description:
What a house! It's all steel and glass and elegance... and it all belongs to Arthur Kriticos and his family as an unexpected inheritance. You could say it's their dream home. Especially if the dreams are nightmares.

Awesome ectoplasmic specters populate THIR13EN GHOSTS, an effects-rampant remake of the 1960 William Castle haunted-house film from producers Gilbert Adler, Joel Silver, and Robert Zemeckis, who conjured up the equally terror-iffic HOUSE ON HAUNTED HILL (1999). Tony Shalhoub leads a cast that includes Embeth Davidtz, Matthew Lillard, Shannon Elizabeth, Rah Digga, and F. Murray Abraham. The house itself is a design marvel and a mysterious puzzle-cube whose eerie corridors, sliding walls, spinning floors, and phantasmic friends may allow no escape.

35mm print courtesy of HFC.

show.headline: A story about family legacy, broken friendships, and belief itself.

event.title: <show-title>Capturing Bigfoot</show-title><event-type-title> with Live Q&A</event-type-title>
event.headline: Live Q&A featuring director Marq Evans﻿
event.description:
Live Q&A featuring director Marq Evans

On October 20, 1967, Roger Patterson captured 59 seconds of film showing a creature walking through the Northern California woods — footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. Fifty-nine years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything.

CAPTURING BIGFOOT reveals the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.

This is a story about family legacy, broken friendships, and belief itself.

marketStrings.value: The personal closed captioning device displays feature film dialogue and other audio in the form of English-language text for individuals who are deaf or hard of hearing.

The descriptive audio headset provides individuals who are blind or have low vision with an English-language narration of the details of the feature presentation that can't be understood by the soundtrack alone.

Upon request at the box office, we provide assistive listening headsets with amplified audio for those individuals who are hard of hearing. For guests who prefer to use their own hearing aids, neck loops, or cochlear implants, our assistive listening headsets have a 3.5mm headphone jack to connect to those devices.

In order to ensure the highest quality experience for all guests, you may not enter a movie after it has started. We’d love to see you up to 30 minutes early. Running late? No worries, we will happily exchange your ticket for a different showtime or a raincheck to a future show.
